keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Aymeric Laporte (Athletic Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Xavi Espart (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Athletic Club 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pedri with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Aymeric Laporte (Athletic Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Barcelona 1, Athletic Club 0.
Second Half begins Barcelona 1, Athletic Club 0.
Gorka Guruzeta (Athletic Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Robert Navarro replaces Nico Williams.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Alex Berenguer replaces Iñaki Williams.
Johaneko Louis-Jean (Athletic Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Rodri replaces Raphinha.
Substitution, Barcelona. Dani Olmo replaces Marc Bernal.
Delay in match because of an injury Johaneko Louis-Jean (Athletic Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Adama Boiro replaces Johaneko Louis-Jean because of an injury.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Beñat Gerenabarrena replaces Mikel Jauregizar.
Substitution, Barcelona. Jules Koundé replaces Eric García.
